subject: Quick vendor onboarding: NeonMesh Labs pilot — no-PO exception request
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Quick vendor onboarding: NeonMesh Labs pilot — no-PO exception request

Hi Marissa / Logan —

We have a small pilot with NeonMesh Labs (contact: Sophie Chen) to integrate their realtime telemetry adapter into our sandbox environment. Estimated spend is ~$1,200/mo for the next 3 months (pilot only). NeonMesh has asked for a fast vendor intake and said they can invoice monthly but do not take PO numbers in their billing system.

Can we do a conditional no-PO onboarding for this pilot? Proposed controls:
- Spend cap: $2,500/month (hard stop)
- Auto alerts to finance@redwood.com at $1,000 and $2,000 thresholds
- Contract: master services agreement signed — legal has already reviewed and signed off on standard terms (copy attached).

I attached their onboarding form and our quick risk matrix. If procurement & finance are comfortable, we'd like to onboard them this week to start dev work next Monday.

Attachments: onboarding_form_neonmesh.pdf (vendor intake form), qsa_risk_matrix.xlsx

Next steps I need from you:
- Marissa: procurement policy exception (if allowed) or alternative route
- Logan: finance OK to accept invoice-only for pilot and payment routing guidance

Thanks,
Alex Martinez
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

From: Sophie Chen <sophie@neonmesh.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 10:05:12 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick vendor onboarding: NeonMesh Labs pilot — no-PO exception request

Hi Alex —

Thanks for moving quickly. We can absolutely support invoice-only billing for the initial pilot. Our AP team will send monthly invoices to ap@redwood.com with the following on the invoicE: 
- Invoice line items for telemetry adapter (monthly subscription)
- Bank transfer details and remit-to address

I've attached our vendor intake PDF for your records. If procurement needs any certificates (SOC2, ISO), we can provide the attestation page and a redacted scope — those are on our partner portal.

Happy to jump on a 15-min call if that helps accelerate.

Best,
Sophie Chen
Head of Partnerships
NeonMesh Labs
procurement@neonmesh.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 11:40:25 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick vendor onboarding: NeonMesh Labs pilot — no-PO exception request

On Fri, Nov 27, 2026 at 9:12 AM Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.com> wrote:
> We have a small pilot with NeonMesh Labs ...

Thanks for the context, Alex. I reviewed the intake and the preliminary risk matrix — classification looks low/medium. A few clarifying items before I can approve an exception:
1) Can you confirm the total committed spend for the pilot period (3 months)? You mentioned ~$1,200/mo but we need the absolute upper bound.
2) Is there any access to customer data (even pseudonymized telemetry)? If yes, we need the SOC2 excerpt Sophie referenced.
3) Will NeonMesh be added to our vendor allowlist and will they sign the redwood MSA?

If we get the above, procurement can approve a time-bound no-PO path with the following controls:
- Exception end date: 2027-02-27 (3 months)
- Hard spend stop at $3,000 per month (Accounting will block payments past this without PO)
- Weekly spend alerts to procurement and finance; invoices must be routed to ap@redwood.com with vendor reference NEON-345

I can prepare the exception document and route for signature once Logan confirms finance routing.

Marissa
Sr. Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 13:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick vendor onboarding: NeonMesh Labs pilot — no-PO exception request

Thanks all — finance here. Confirming finance is OK to accept invoice-only for this time-bound pilot given the proposed controls. A few finance notes:
- Approved until 2027-02-27 (matches procurement).
- Accounting code to use on all NeonMesh invoices: PROD-ENG-OPS (please include this on the invoice or in the invoice PDF).
- Invoices should be sent to ap@redwood.com and the PO field left blank; accounting will process and post to the above code.
- We require vendor bank details or an ACH form before the first payment. Sophie, can you send bank remit details to ap@redwood.com (or upload to your partner portal and share the link)?

I'll also set up an automated alert at $1,000 and $2,000 thresholds to be sent to procurement and engineering. If we hit $3,000 in a month, accounting will hold further payments until a PO is supplied.

Logan Wright
Finance Manager, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Chen <sophie@neonmesh.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 16:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick vendor onboarding: NeonMesh Labs pilot — no-PO exception request

Perfect — thanks Marissa & Logan. Recap and next steps for clarity:
1) NeonMesh (Sophie) to upload bank remit / ACH to the partner portal or send to ap@redwood.com.
2) Sophie to send first invoice for December to ap@redwood.com and include vendor reference NEON-345 and accounting code PROD-ENG-OPS.
3) Procurement (Marissa) to publish the formal exception (end date 2027-02-27) and add the weekly alert rule to OPS-5123 (linked).
4) Engineering (me) will onboard the telemetry adapter in the sandbox once vendor is in allowlist and we've validated the attestation doc.

Sophie — thanks for the quick turnaround. If you can confirm upload/invoice ETA (this afternoon or Monday morning) we'll proceed.

Cheers,
Alex Martinez
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
